system.description:
Cold blue fire arcs from the wizard’s hand into the very soul of his prey, draining his strength. Meeting the obstacle temporarily drains 1D of Forte from the victim. Each success over the obstacle drains an additional point of Forte. Reducing Forte to zero incapacitates the victim. Forte recovers at 1D per exchange. Weapon Length: as Polearm; Range: as Pistol.

Obstacle: Forte of Victim^. Actions: 4.

Origin: Presence | Area of Effect: Single Target | Element: White | Impetus: Tax | Duration: Instantaneous | Resource Points: 12

^ When pricing this spell in resource points, it costs 4 rps per point of obstacle rather than 2.

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 212
